{{Quote|Glad to share my skills with someone talented.|Phrayan|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Phrayan''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi instructor|Jedi combat instructor]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] with blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Phrayan wore [[Armor/Legends|armored]] gray [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] and carried a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] while stationed in [[Voss-Ka]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phrayan first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as a trainer for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class on the planet Voss.<ref name="TOR" />
